content: Breath — James Nestor. Journalist's global investigation into breathing science: nasal vs. mouth breathing, ancient techniques (pranayama, Buteyko) validated by modern research, and how ~90% of people breathe badly in ways that quietly drive chronic ailments.

content: Bad Actors — Mick Herron. Slough House book 8: a Downing Street think-tank member vanishes and the trail leads back into MI5's own leadership, dragging the slow horses into the fallout.

Gladiator — Con Iggulden. Roman gladiatorial-combat historical fiction; note: no standalone novel by this exact title could be confirmed in Iggulden's published bibliography during research — page flags this for Fred to verify/correct.
